title: PF kya hai? Salary se kaise kat-ta hai?
tag: PF GURU JI #02 · PF KYA HAI

brief.topic: PF kya hai, employee par iska kya asar hota hai, aur salary se PF kaise kat-ta hai?

repeat_check.different_because: Ep01 claim reject ki wajah aur fix batata hai; yeh reel PF ki basic samajh, employee par asar aur salary se deduction kaise hoti hai, batata hai — claim ka sawaal hi nahi.

brief.viewer: Koi bhi salaried employee, khaas taur par pehli naukri wala, jiski salary se PF kat-ta hai aur use samajh nahi aata yeh paisa kya hai, kahan jata hai, aur kab milega.
brief.hook: Salary aayi, PF kat gaya — yeh paisa kahan gaya?
brief.problem: PF katne se in-hand salary kam milti hai, aur member ko samajh nahi aata yeh paisa kahan gaya, company bhi kuch deti hai ya nahi, aur yeh kab milega.
why: PF retirement ke liye bachat hai — EPF Scheme ke tahat employee aur employer dono har mahine contribute karte hain
Contribution Basic + DA par 12% hai, isliye salary slip mein har mahine deduction dikhta hai
Employer ke hisse ka 8.33% pension (EPS) mein jata hai, isliye passbook mein employer ka EPF hissa chhota dikhta hai
steps: Salary slip mein Basic + DA dekho — PF usi par 12% kat-ta hai
Apna 12% aur company ka 12% passbook mein dekho — maan lo Basic + DA Rs 25,000 hai to dono taraf se Rs 3,000 jama hota hai
Samjho company ka hissa salary se nahi kat-ta — woh alag se jata hai, usme se 8.33% pension mein aur 3.67% PF mein
Interest har saal judta hai — passbook mein balance badhta dekho, aur poora PF naukri chhodne ke 12 mahine baad milega
brief.check: Passbook mein apna share, company ka share aur pension wala hissa alag-alag dekho — teeno ka jod har mahine Rs 6,000 hona chahiye is example mein.
brief.help: Passbook ya balance dekhne mein dikkat ho to EPFO member portal par passbook dekho, ya EPFiGMS par shikayat karo. EPFO ki services free hain.
brief.share_target: Us dost ko abhi bhejo jiski pehli salary se PF kata hai
brief.why_now: Evergreen: har naye employee ka pehla sawaal — salary se PF kyun kata? Aur wage ceiling 17 September 2026 se Rs 25,000 hui hai, isliye ab zyada logo par PF lagta hai.

data.label: PF kya hai
data.statement: PF retirement ke liye bachat hai — employee aur employer dono har mahine contribute karte hain, aur paisa member ke PF account mein jama hota hai.
data.check_note: Scheme ke tahat PF post-retirement benefit hai; person Gazette mein scheme ke objective/coverage paras se confirm karein.

data.label: Employee ka PF rate
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 18 (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 18: employee 12% of wages; notified class of establishments 10%. Person Gazette mein para 18 khol kar rate aur 'wages' ki definition confirm karein.

data.label: Employer ka PF rate
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 18 (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 18: employer bhi 12% of wages. Person Gazette mein para 18 confirm karein.

data.label: Employer ke hisse mein pension wala hissa
data.check_note: EPS 2026 para 4: employer ke 12% mein se 8.33% pension fund mein jata hai. Person Gazette mein para 4 confirm karein.

data.label: Employer ke hisse mein PF account wala hissa
PF wage ceiling (monthly)
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 23 September 2026: EPFO Raises Wage Ceiling from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 25,000
data.check_note: Cabinet ne 16 September 2026 ko ceiling Rs 15,000 se Rs 25,000 karne ko approve kiya; 17 September 2026 se lagu (S.O. 5109(E)). Person PIB release aur gazette notification se date aur rakam confirm karein — purane pages abhi bhi Rs 15,000 dikhate hain.

data.label: EPF interest rate FY 2025-26
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 2 March 2026: 239th CBT meeting
data.check_note: Quote: 'CBT recommended 8.25% annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members' accounts for the financial year 2025-26.' Rate har saal declare hota hai; FY 2024-25 bhi 8.25% tha.

data.label: Example: Basic + DA
data.note: Example. Maan lo Basic + DA Rs 25,000 hai — yeh wage ceiling ke barabar hai, isliye isse zyada par mandatory contribution nahi badhta. Member ki apni salary slip mein asli Basic + DA hota hai.

data.label: Example: employer ke hisse mein pension
Example: employer ke hisse mein PF account
Employer ka hissa salary se nahi kat-ta
data.statement: Employer apna 12% hissa employee ki salary se nahi kaat sakta — woh company ki taraf se alag se jama hota hai.
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 21 (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 21: employer contribution employer ki taraf se hai, member ki wages se deduct nahi hoti. Person Gazette mein para 21 confirm karein.

data.label: Naukri chhodne ke baad poora PF kab milega
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 49(2), first proviso (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Gazette pp. 90-91: member eligible nahi 'unless the member has not been employed ... for a continuous period of not less than twelve months'. Ep01 mein bhi yahi fact use hua tha.

data.label: Passbook member portal par dekho
data.statement: Member apna PF passbook member portal par dekh sakta hai.
data.check_note: Person member portal khol kar passbook link confirm karein.

data.label: Example 2: Basic + DA
data.note: Example. Maan lo Basic + DA Rs 20,000 hai — Rs 25,000 ceiling se neeche, isliye poori Basic + DA par 12% kat-ta hai. Member ki apni salary slip mein asli Basic + DA hota hai.

script.vo: Salary aayi, PF kat gaya. Yeh paisa kahan gaya?
script.tts: सैलरी आई, पीएफ कट गया। ये पैसा कहाँ गया?

script.vo: Ghabrao mat. Yeh bacha hai.
script.tts: घबराओ मत। ये बचा है।

script.vo: PF retirement ke liye bachat hai. Har mahine kat-ta hai.
script.tts: पीएफ रिटायरमेंट के लिए बचत है। हर महीने कटता है।

script.vo: In-hand kam milta hai. Paisa kahan gaya?
script.tts: इन-हैंड कम मिलता है। पैसा कहाँ गया?

script.vo: Ek: aap 12% dete ho, Basic plus DA par.
script.tts: एक: आप बारह प्रतिशत देते हो, बेसिक प्लस डीए पर।

script.vo: Do: company bhi 12% deti hai, aapki salary se nahi.
script.tts: दो: कंपनी भी बारह प्रतिशत देती है, आपकी सैलरी से नहीं।

script.vo: Teen: pension banti hai, PF bhi badhta hai.
script.tts: तीन: पेंशन बनती है, पीएफ भी बढ़ता है।

script.vo: Maan lo, Basic plus DA ₹25,000 hai, yahi ceiling hai.
script.tts: मान लो, बेसिक प्लस डीए पच्चीस हज़ार रुपये है, यही सीलिंग है।

script.vo: Company bhi ₹3,000 deti hai. Kul ₹6,000 har mahine jama.
script.tts: कंपनी भी तीन हज़ार रुपये देती है। कुल छह हज़ार रुपये हर महीने जमा।

script.vo: Basic ₹20,000 ho to, aap ₹2,400 dete ho.
script.tts: बेसिक बीस हज़ार रुपये हो तो, आप दो हज़ार चार सौ रुपये देते हो।

script.vo: Company bhi ₹2,400 deti hai. Kul ₹4,800 har mahine.
script.tts: कंपनी भी दो हज़ार चार सौ रुपये देती है। कुल चार हज़ार आठ सौ रुपये हर महीने।

script.vo: Salary ₹25,000 se zyada? PF sirf ₹25,000 par kat-ta hai.
script.tts: सैलरी पच्चीस हज़ार रुपये से ज़्यादा? पीएफ सिर्फ़ पच्चीस हज़ार रुपये पर कटता है।

script.vo: Ek hissa PF mein, baaki pension mein.
script.tts: एक हिस्सा पीएफ़ में, बाक़ी पेंशन में।

script.vo: Har saal interest judta hai.
script.tts: हर साल इंटरेस्ट जुड़ता है।

script.vo: Poora PF kab milega? Naukri chhodne ke 12 mahine baad.
script.tts: पूरा पीएफ कब मिलेगा? नौकरी छोड़ने के बारह महीने बाद।

script.vo: Passbook mein teeno hissa dekho.
script.tts: पासबुक में तीनों हिस्सा देखो।

script.vo: Salary slip mein dekho. PF wali line mein ₹3,000 dikhega.
script.tts: सैलरी स्लिप में देखो। पीएफ वाली लाइन में तीन हज़ार रुपये दिखेगा।

script.vo: Passbook na dikhe? Portal par dobara dekho.
script.tts: पासबुक न दिखे? पोर्टल पर दोबारा देखो।

script.vo: Jiski pehli salary se PF kata, us dost ko abhi bhejo.
script.tts: जिसकी पहली सैलरी से पीएफ कटा, उस दोस्त को अभी भेजो।

script.vo: PF samjho, claim pao. EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo PF Guru Ji.
script.tts: पीएफ समझो, क्लेम पाओ। ईपीएफओ की हर जानकारी चाहिए? फ़ॉलो करो पीएफ गुरु जी।

post.caption:
Salary aayi, PF kat gaya? Ghabrao mat. Yeh kata nahi, bacha hai.

PF retirement ke liye bachat hai. Aap Basic + DA par 12% dete ho, company bhi 12% deti hai. Maan lo Basic + DA ₹25,000 hai, to har mahine ₹6,000 jama hota hai, aur 8.25% interest judta hai. Poora PF naukri chhodne ke 12 mahine baad milega.

Passbook mein apna, company ka aur pension ka hissa alag-alag dekho.

EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo @pfguruji.

PF Guru Ji EPFO ka official channel nahi hai. Niyam: epfo.gov.in
